'''2001 West Virginia State Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG state championship held in West Virginia on 12 May 2001. [[John Tatta]] won it. It is known from John Tatta's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2305">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-14-wv-states-5-12-01d2305/ wv-states-5-12-01], DeckTech (John "Artoo-Detoo" Tatta, 14 May 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-14-wv-states-5-12-01d2305/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 12 May 2001
* '''Site:''' West Virginia
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[John Tatta]]

== Tournament reports ==

Players' own reports from this event.

* [[John Tatta WV States 5-12-01 (tournament report)]] — by [[John Tatta]], 1st, 8–0
* [[Michael Adams WV State Tournament Report 5-12-01 (tournament report)]] — by [[Michael Adams]], 4th, 3–2

== Discrepancies ==

Where a source disagrees with the record on this page, the page keeps the record and notes the difference here.

* John Tatta's report gives the top five as Tatta 12 (+120), A.J. Clemans 8 (+80), Emerson Sklar 8 (+35), Mike Adams 8 (+14), Chris Warder 6 (+12); Mike Adams's report gives Tatta 12 (+147), Clemans 8 (+52), Sklar 8 (+37), Adams 8 (+36), Chad Reedy 5th 6 (+33) and Warder 6th 6 (+15).<ref name="tr-d2305" />
* Mike Adams's standings list Tatta 12 (+147), A.J. Clemans 8 (+52), Emerson Sklar 8 (+37), Adams 8 (+36), Chad Reedy 5th 6 (+33), Chris Warder 6th 6 (+15); John Tatta's report gives Tatta 12 (+120), Clemans 8 (+80), Sklar 8 (+35), Adams 8 (+14) and Warder 5th 6 (+12).<ref name="tr-d2315" />
